remediation.change: Removed unsupported exact-version claims from the pack, source builder and authored summaries. Retained direct Shimano pt-BR MASTIFF FC 90m product identity and numeric SKU/japanAdminCode scope. Raw primary evidence and assets were not edited.

findings.resolution: Unsupported version attribution removed from pack, builder and authored summaries; numerical proof and all row values preserved. Historical finding below describes the original reviewed pack.
findings.title: Remove or substantiate the LB-B41V source-verification claim
findings.claim: The config says the LB-B41V 90-meter version is explicitly identified and documented on the Brazilian source page; the code also appears in all ten numeric evidence strings.
findings.observed: The raw primary response identifies MASTIFF FC 90m, fluorocarbon, NANOARMOR, all ten lb/mm/90m rows and numeric SKU/japanAdminCode values. Its table was independently re-parsed and matches the pack. The primary image shows Mastiff FC 12lb, .285mm and 90m. None of the saved primary responses or inspected product image establishes LB-B41V. A case-insensitive B41V search of the evidence directory finds only the author-generated reviewed.json, not primary proof.
findings.impact: The exact formulation/version identifier is attributed to a source that does not contain it. This is a provenance gap, not a finding that the ten numeric rows or the 90m product identity are false.
findings.requestedAction: Before publishing the affected text, remove the unsupported LB-B41V assertions from reason, row evidence and visible gold fields, retaining the directly evidenced Shimano pt-BR MASTIFF FC 90m scope and numeric SKU codes; alternatively provide an exact primary source establishing the version mapping. Do not substitute US 200yd data or change verified numeric rows merely to address this wording issue.
findings.blocks: Exact-version source-verification claim as written; does not block the separately proven numeric subset after attribution correction.

method: Read final pack, handoff and source metadata; restricted candidates to status source-verified.
Independently parsed raw Shimano and Sunline HTML tables with an HTML event parser, without running Group A builders. Six raw table extractions exactly match the supplied parsed tables.

Compared each accepted diameter/strength/package combination against raw public LINES JSON, raw Shopify variant responses, raw HTML tables and exact lineup titles. Sunline Crank numeric chart was visually read independently.
Verified Daiwa's own saved page declares DAIWA_SHEETS_PROXY and invokes the cited LINES endpoint. Matched exact color/product handles rather than treating every proxy row as the same product.

Independently found and parsed 68 embedded specification records in XBraid's own raw product page; all 41 accepted ML package combinations match directly, in addition to the Daiwa distributor response.

Visually inspected all 13 active local manufacturer images, checked their metadata and representative-versus-exact-SKU scope, and compared readable package labels against accepted or explicitly held rows.

Checked all metric diameter/package conversions, all 13 selected default line/package pairs, and both leader configs' role, exact Fluorocarbon Leader type and empty exampleSetups. No shared data or build scripts read or modified for these checks.
